decisions.reason: The font-guidance clarification from message 39 is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, including that font details are included instead of a separate guidelines project.
The separate message-39 decision limiting delivery to the three standard colour variants is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
Clarifying that colour details and codes are included without a separate guidelines document does not change the requirement to provide fully editable source files.
The clarification about included brand-colour details and exclusion of a separate guidelines document does not alter delivery of versions with and without the black box.
Providing the colour details and codes used in the approved design documents the existing colour treatment; it does not modify the approved colours themselves.
The documentation-scope clarification does not change rev8-11 as the approved final composition.
The source decision concerns included brand-colour documentation rather than the strapline's lines or graduated-colour presentation.
The distinction between colour/font details and a separate guidelines project does not alter any approved letterform requirement.
The source decision does not change the company name, exclusion of the word 'truck', or the intended breadth of brand representation.
The brand-colour documentation clarification does not affect the flame-based O or its recognition requirement.
The source decision narrows the requested documentation deliverable and does not modify the logo's visual-character direction or ornamentation constraint.
The clarification of final brand-colour documentation has no effect on the earlier concept-development requirements.
